# Data Sources, Licences and Credits {#sec-sources}

Every number in this book is computed, when the book is built, from the data files listed here, or carries
its own citation in the text. Each data row in the London files records its source, address and retrieval
date; the water data's full provenance, including every table's licence and cut-off date, is in
`examples/water/data/README.md` in the workshop repository.

## London (Part II) {.unnumbered}

- **Visits.** Association of Leading Visitor Attractions (ALVA), *Visits made in 2025 to visitor attractions
  in membership with ALVA*, <https://www.alva.org.uk/details.cfm?p=423>, and the same tables for 2015 to 2024
  (`details.cfm?p=` 606, 607, 608, 609, 610, 615, 616, 617, 618 and 619), retrieved 2026-10-30. ALVA counts its
  members only, so the book writes "ALVA member attractions".
- **Facts about the sights** (`data/sights.csv`): each sight's official visitor page, and for the National
  Gallery's nearest station, Transport for London's StopPoint service, checked 2026-11-01.
- **Churches.** Visit London, *Cathedrals and churches in London*, retrieved 2026-10-31.
- **Places.** Coordinates from [Wikidata](https://www.wikidata.org/), CC0, retrieved 2026-11-01.
- **Borough boundaries.** Office for National Statistics, Local Authority Districts (December 2024) boundaries,
  Open Government Licence v3.0; contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2024. Retrieved
  2026-11-01.

## Colombia (Part III) {.unnumbered}

- **IRCA.** Instituto Nacional de Salud (INS), *Calidad del Agua para Consumo Humano en Colombia*,
  [datos.gov.co `nxt2-39c3`](https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/nxt2-39c3.csv), CC BY-SA 4.0: the
  utility-supplied ("prestadores") IRCA.
- **Risk bands.** Ministerio de la Protección Social and MAVDT,
  [Resolución 2115 de 2007, art. 15](https://normas.cra.gov.co/gestor/docs/resolucion_minproteccion_2115_2007.htm).
  National figures: MinSalud, MinVivienda, INS and Superservicios, *INCA 2023* (Bogotá, January 2025), Tabla 4.
- **Coverage, poverty, municipal performance, transfers, region and infant mortality.** DNP
  [TerriData](https://terridata.dnp.gov.co/) (from Superservicios, DANE, DNP-SICODIS and MinSalud).
- **Municipalities, population and boundaries.** DANE: DIVIPOLA
  ([`gdxc-w37w`](https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/gdxc-w37w.json)), municipal population projections for
  2005–2017 and 2018–2042, and the 2023 national geostatistical framework (MGN 2023).
- **Education.** ICFES Saber 11 ([`kgxf-xxbe`](https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/kgxf-xxbe.csv),
  [`rnvb-vnyh`](https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/rnvb-vnyh.csv)); MEN school dropout
  ([`nudc-7mev`](https://www.datos.gov.co/resource/nudc-7mev.csv)).
- **Rainfall.** [CHIRPS v3.0](https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps3), Funk et al. (2026), *Scientific Data*
  13, 718, <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-026-07096-4>; data <https://doi.org/10.15780/G2JQ0P>.
- **Altitude (derived).** NASA SRTM GL3, <https://doi.org/10.5067/MEaSUREs/SRTM/SRTMGL3.003>, through
  [OpenTopoData](https://www.opentopodata.org/datasets/srtm/).

The data were retrieved on 2026-10-30. Nothing in Part III is synthetic except the toy points that illustrate
k-means in @sec-kmeans-steps, which are labelled as such.

## Other material {.unnumbered}

- **Pelican drawings** (@sec-choose): Simon Willison's
  [pelican riding a bicycle](https://simonwillison.net/tags/pelican-riding-a-bicycle/) series, one run per
  model and effort, from his published transcripts for
  [Haiku 5.5](https://gist.github.com/simonw/485dfa24b4efa1267ee2d0911594fb81),
  [Sonnet 5.5](https://gist.github.com/simonw/1d85a9be7f3ecce26e7f1569161a0d01),
  [Opus 5.5](https://gist.github.com/simonw/61fd7c3683fffce9a3ab7c43d1180024) and
  [Fable 5.1](https://gist.github.com/simonw/17318f748f8c2b476051ddc2ebeb94a7). No licence is stated on them;
  they are reproduced with credit and links.
- **Software.** Quarto (MIT License), Pandoc, Typst, Python, pandas, matplotlib, scikit-learn and three.js
  (MIT License), each under its own open-source licence.
- **Animations and diagrams** were made for this book or for the workshop's slides. The chat, agent and
  Windows animations are illustrations, as their captions say; the other terminal animations, the preview and
  the 3-D scenes are real recordings, made with a demo account where a terminal is shown.
